[Press Release] SML Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "SML Mahindra to raise upto Rs. 1450 crore through Rights Issue ".

[Rights Issue] SML Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 16, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 2 : 7, i.e 2 Equity Shares for every 7 Equity Shares held. Rights Issue Price is Rs. 3506 per share.

[Rights Issue] SML Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 06, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis.
